habits that make you seem
incredibly well read

quoting a line of poetry
at just the right moment

knowing where everyday
expressions come from

writing little notes
in the margins

having the perfect book
for every friend

reading the classics,
not the summaries

knowing a little about everything

i learn one thing every day.

knowing a little about everything

i learn one thing every day on
an app like Sophia.
